entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Automated Agent. How can I help you today?
I want to return something. I've been on hold forever. This is ridiculous!

I understand your frustration, I'm sorry for the wait time. My name is Alex, and I'd be happy to assist you with your return today. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's order number VF12345. I bought a VeloBand Pulse and I want to return it. It's not what I expected at all.
Thank you. I see your order here. You purchased a VeloBand Pulse. I understand you'd like to return it. Could you tell me what you didn’t like about the smart watch?
That's not important! I just don't want it. The interface is clunky and it's not tracking my sleep correctly. I want my money back. How do I start the return?
Of course. Let me check our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return policy is a full refund within 90 days of purchase. Let me process this for you.
90 days? Okay, finally! I thought I was going to be stuck with this thing. I’ve only had it for about 15 days.
Great! Just to confirm, you are returning the VeloBand Pulse, correct? And you purchased it 15 days ago?
Yes, that's right! 15 days. VeloBand Pulse. Return it!

Perfect. I've initiated the return for you. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email within the next 24 hours. Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, we'll process your refund. It should appear in your account within 7-10 business days.
Seriously? That's it? No hassles? No questions asked?
That's correct. We want you to be completely satisfied with your VeloFit experience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, I'm actually impressed. The last person I spoke with was useless. Thank you so much, Alex. You’ve been a great help.
You're very welcome! We are always happy to help. Have a wonderful day!
